root_idea.summary: The root centers on aid and support: assistance given, assistance exchanged mutually, and assistance requested from another.
root_idea.development: The supplied evidence shows derived forms for giving aid, mutual cooperation, seeking aid, and being the one whose aid is sought. It also preserves separate form-specific branches such as عَوَان for intermediate age and figurative extensions from that sense; these are not treated as a universal meaning of every root derivative.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form أَعَانَ.
Displayed under the normalized Form VI perfect citation form تَعَاوَنَ.
Displayed under the normalized Form X perfect citation form اِسْتَعَانَ.
Displayed under the normalized nominal citation form عَوَان.
Displayed as the passive participle citation form مُسْتَعَان.

senses.definition: To aid, help, or assist someone; to help someone accomplish an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive. It may occur with عَلَى in the construction “to aid someone in accomplishing an affair.”

senses.definition: To aid one another; to cooperate through mutual assistance.
senses.usage_conditions: Reciprocal construction. It may be used with عَلَى for mutually helping one another to accomplish an affair.

senses.definition: To seek, request, or beg for aid or assistance.
senses.usage_conditions: It may be construed with بِـ for seeking aid from a person or using something as a means, and may specify the affair for which aid is sought.

senses.definition: Intermediate in age; neither young nor old.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, it describes a cow as being of middle age, between youth and advanced age.

senses.definition: One whose aid is sought; an entity appealed to for assistance.
senses.usage_conditions: Passive-participial noun from اِسْتَعَانَ, naming the person or power from whom assistance is requested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become intermediate in age, reaching the state described as عَوَان.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of a woman or a cow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a he-ass, to mate with his she-ass repeatedly or frequently.
To encroach on another person’s share or portion.
To aid, help, or assist someone, being aided by that person in return.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicit synonym of أَعَانَ in the supplied evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shave the pubic hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate Classical Arabic usage from the aid-seeking verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Aid, help, or assistance; also anything that aids another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may function quasi-verbally and govern like a verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An aider, helper, or assistant; by extension, a servant or an armed attendant, guard, or official.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, and also used for an attendant serving a ruler or similar authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dates and salt; in one reported pronunciation, salt alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The salt designation is explained metaphorically as something whose aid is sought in eating food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A herd of wild asses; also a she-ass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plural is reported as عُون or عَانَات.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for certain white stars beneath the stars called السُّعُود.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative or transferred astronomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pubic hair or the place where it grows above the anterior pudendum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to the hair itself or, by extension, its place of growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the idiom عَلَى عَانَةِ بَكْرِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ, the collective body of a tribe and those under its protection; hence, its manager or regulator.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Idiomatic and context-bound usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A share of water allotted to land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage attributed to the dialect of ʿAbd al-Qays.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A previously married woman, one who has had a husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical specialization distinct from the general sense of intermediate age.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, recurring after an earlier occurrence: a war in which fighting has occurred once and is occurring again, or a blow delivered opportunistically and requiring repetition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expressions حَرْبٌ عَوَانٌ and ضَرْبَةٌ عَوَانٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land watered by rain lying between two portions of land that have not been so watered.
A tall palm-tree; also a palm standing alone apart from others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage attributed to Oman or the Azd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small creeping creature, described as smaller than a hedgehog, or a sand worm that turns repeatedly in the sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare zoological usage with variant descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine from ʿĀnah, a town on the Euphrates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used substantivally for the wine and in expressions concerning its vintners.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An official appointed to rectify the affairs of the common people and aid the wronged against the wrongdoer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A post-Classical administrative title, treated here as a lexical phrase rather than as the ordinary noun عَوْن.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mansion or residence of the شِحْنَة in Cairo.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A historical proper designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who aids, helps, or assists people frequently or particularly well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is مَعَاوِين.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fully mature and well-developed or proportioned; applied to a fleshy or symmetrical woman, and to a hackney whose strength and age have reached full development.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported descriptions vary between fleshiness, symmetry, and full physical maturity.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Explicit synonymy with أَعَانَ is covered by the represented aid meaning.
Full physical development is covered by the grouped mature/developed meaning.

cautions: The Form IV, Form VI, and Form X Quran groups are displayed under normalized perfect-tense dictionary citations rather than their inflected Quran surface forms.
Lane's printed Quran reference associated with عَوَان uses an older citation convention; the example location 2:68 is used because it is independently supplied by QAC and the Quran-focused evidence.
